When she returns to work on Monday, circumstances throw Louise into an unexpected entanglement. She encounters David, not only her new boss but also the mysterious barman from her previous night. He is married, yet he can't seem to take his eyes off her. Adding to the complexity is Adele, a newcomer to the city who needs a friendâonly for Louise to discover that Adele is actually engaged to David.

As Louise gets drawn into the orbit of David and Adele, she struggles to understand the situation. Why is David obsessed with control? And what makes Adele so fearful? The more invested Louise becomes in their relationship, the more questions arise, leaving her with fewer answers. One thing remains clear: something deeply wrong permeates this seemingly perfect marriage.

## A Mystery Unfolding

The central question driving *Prin ochii ei* is simple: how far can someone go to protect the secrets of a marriage? This novel takes readers through a mesmerizing journey as Louise grapples with suspicion and truth. It is a masterclass in suspense, where every encounter hints at a deeper, more dangerous secret lurking beneath the surface of domestic life.

As the plot thickens, *Prin ochii ei* challenges the reader's perception. If you think you know how this story will end, think again. The narrative builds to a shocking climax that proves that everyone involved may have been complicit in a terrible game of lies and manipulation.
